model_training.purpose: Source-backed architecture, training and evaluation evidence for the single ST3D project report

architecture.parameter_scope: ST3D reconstruction network only; TrackNet detector excluded
architecture.effective_inputs: Observed ball UV and confidence, visibility mask, physical time, 13 projected court points, 24x24 grayscale crop and heatmap, crop center and scale. Explicit K/R/C slots are zero in A_keypoints.

token_embedding.fusion: Sum of merged ball/court token, crop metadata projection, and CNN embedding; time goes to rotary attention

image_encoder.normalization: Per frame/channel mean and standard deviation; standard deviation minimum 0.02

temporal.remaining_keys: All non-padding time steps; missing queries are reconstructed
block_order: Seconds-based rotary positions on Q and K
Scaled dot-product attention, six heads, no dropout
FFN linear 192 -> 768, GELU, linear 768 -> 192 and residual

inference.mode: Offline complete-rally coverage from overlapping windows

original_model_training.initialization: random initialization, no warm start from smaller datasets
original_model_training.time_scope: Training-loop wall clock, including on-the-fly rendering, explicit duty-cycle sleeps, checkpoint saves and scheduled dev evaluation. Excludes separate initial dataset/cache construction and final full test evaluation. Not pure GPU compute time.

train_length.sampling: Independent uniform integer length per batch; random contiguous crop within each trajectory; pad only if trajectory shorter than requested length; not fixed192 and not always full rally

original_model_training.view_schedule: One of four views per trajectory visit, rotating with epoch
original_model_training.precision: BF16 autocast for network forward; FP32 parameters and targets; EMA weights used at evaluation
original_model_training.loss: Per-trajectory mean squared error on normalized XYZ over non-padding frames

recent_campaigns.time_scope: Recorded entire campaign elapsed; includes preparation, training and validation. Do not call this one model training time.

official_comparison.campaign_time_note: One scheduled comparison campaign elapsed, not total historical cost of all method weights; ST3D reused earlier training exposure.
official_comparison.limitations: Official author code adapted to badminton; missing-frame adapters, inputs and supervision differ. Not original table-tennis paper reproduction, nor a pure one-component architecture ablation.

real_evaluation.aggregation: Compute each rally metric first, then equally average 12 rallies
real_evaluation.limitations: Previously exposed fixed-camera public videos, possible detector pretraining overlap. Approximate manual court calibration and explicit geometric/temporal postprocessing. Projection error is not true3D error.

videos.display_sampling: nearest source frame at15fps; original duration retained
videos.display_scene: Calibrated projection of the same court and physical XYZ; illustrative scene only, network input remains stored local crop and heatmap.

calibration.assumptions: Square pixels, zero skew/distortion, principal point at image center; approximate monocular camera, for projection checks only

base.denominator: All visible-labeled frames, including detector misses

refined.denominator: All visible-labeled frames, including detector misses

notes: Frozen weights, context192, same 360 frames, same outlier and refinement rules; only the detector ROI differs.
Fixed 24 sampled frames, 15 visually usable AI-assisted labels; 9 uncertain points excluded identically for all arms.
Not expert human ground truth; approximately 3–5 source-pixel annotation uncertainty.
All projections are in original 1280x720 coordinates after inverse background homography.
Recall is raw detections within <=20 pixels divided by the same 15 labels; misses count as failures.
Projection scores are averaged on those 15 points; negative-height counts cover all 360 frames.

demo_candidates.title: 4个完整回合：修正前后对照与展示选择
notes: All four frozen candidate rallies shown; best-presenting candidate2 selected for demonstration after scoring, not an unbiased single-case aggregate.
Four complete rallies from the existing TrackNet dataset family, not cross-dataset generalization evidence.
Independent human 2D shuttle annotations; no 3D ground truth.
Projection means use all visible-labeled frames, including detector misses. Negative-height counts use full rallies.
Detector pretraining overlap for the exact checkpoint is unknown; Test split alone does not establish independence.
Manual approximate camera, overlap fusion and light refinement; low image error does not prove depth accuracy.
